scene: The dispenser clicks loudly, opening three secret transit doors along the wall.
picture: Flat side view inside the laundromat. The player stands centre in yellow raincoat and boots. On the left sits a glass sliding door opening onto a misty ferry dock. Up high above dryers hangs an open cable car hatch. On the right, a tiled subway portal reveals train headlights.
shown: a sliding glass door marked with an anchor on the left
a suspended metal gondola door waiting wide open up high
a lit tiled staircase leading down to tracks on the right

variants.scene: The machine hums, revealing three hidden routes out of the laundromat.
Humming {tune}, you notice three secret ways to travel just unlocked.
Fresh paths appear across the water, above the roof, and underground.
